task.name: Install_camp_lighting
task.when: During Build after each supporting structure passes inspection

step.action: Confirm the current lighting, cable, load, support, and control plan in 📦 Build_Book.
Inspect every light, cord, plug, connector, and support before installation.
step.ifThen: IF insulation, a plug, connector, housing, or support is damaged, THEN remove that component from service.

step.action: Mount each light to the support and position shown in the plan.
Route every de-energized cable clear of traffic, water, fuel, sharp edges, and tension.
Connect each de-energized circuit to the planned control and power point.
Energize one planned circuit at a time.
step.ifThen: IF a protective device trips, a cable heats, or a light behaves abnormally, THEN de-energize the circuit and keep it out of service.

step.action: Test the emergency disconnect and return it to the normal state.

passWhen.criterion: Every planned light and control operates.
No damaged component, overloaded circuit, hot cable, exposed connection, or trip hazard remains.
Every cable route and emergency disconnect is accessible.
The Power Lead completed the final inspection.
